book.name: 2 Abhakʉrintʉ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ya kabhɨrɨ ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhakʉrintʉ

content: Nɨtaana ha kʉbhaandɨkɨra igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉsakirya bhwanyu kwa abharɨndu bha Mungu,

kʉ kʉbha nɨmɨnyirɨ munu umwʉyʉ gwʉ ʉkʉbhasakirya abhandɨ. Necho kikugirya niriikumya igʉrʉ waanyu kʉbhaatʉ bha Makɨdʉniya, nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, imwɨ abhaatʉ bhi icharʉ cha Akaaya, mukiihurucha kuhurucha kwɨma umwaka gʉnʉ gwahitirɨ. Umucha gwanyu gʉkʉrirɨ abhaaru gatɨ waabhʉ kʉbha nu umwʉyʉ gwu ukuhurucha.

Mmbe, nɨratʉma abhakɨndichɨtʉ bhanʉ, korereke mʉtʉrɨ kwerecha maheene kʉbha mukiihurucha kuhurucha, chɨmbu nabhabhuuriirɨ abhaatʉ bha Makɨdʉniya. Nɨtakwenda amangʼana ganʉ niikumiiryɨ igʉrʉ waanyu, garorekanɨ gataana bhwera.

Gayo gʉʉsi ɨtaaza kʉbha sʉni hanʉ niriizɨ kwa niimwɨ hamwɨmwɨ na Abhamakɨdʉniya abhandɨ na kobhona mʉkɨɨrɨ kʉbhanʉra, chɨmbu twarɨ nu ubhwisɨgi bhʉkʉrʉ kurwa kwa niimwɨ, na niimwɨ korora zɨsʉni bhʉkʉngʼu.

Nangʉ nɨkarora nɨ‑bhwaheene nɨbhasabhɨ abhakɨndichɨtʉ bhanʉ bhakangatɨ kuuza kwa niimwɨ, korereke mʉtʉʉrɨ bhwaheene ebhegero chɨmbu mwaragirɨ kuhurucha. Kʉnzɨra yiyo mʉrabha muhurukiryɨ kwa kwenda imubheene, ɨtarɨ kwa kʉhatɨkwa.
Muhiitɨ ringʼana rɨnʉ, “Wʉnʉ akʉhamba bhisuuhu, aragesa bhisuuhu, na wʉnʉ akʉhamba bhyaru, aragesa bhyaru.”
Abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhahuruchɨ chɨmbu bhɨɨndirɨ mumyʉyʉ jabhʉ, bhatahurucha kwa kwitiimaata hamwɨ kwa kʉhatɨkwa, kʉ kʉbha Mungu asɨɨgirɨ abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakuhurucha kumwʉyʉ gʉmwɨ.
Mungu aratʉra kʉbharorera ɨbhɨgʉngi kʉkɨra chɨmbu mukwenda, korereke ibhaga ryʉsi mʉbhɨ na bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ mukwenda, na mongʼehe kokora amazʉmu bhʉkʉngʼu.
Mungu newe akoha ʉmʉhambi zimbusurʉ zʉ ʉkʉhamba ni ibhyakurya. Ɨbhuɨbhu, arabhaha imwɨ zendetere zʉ ʉkʉhamba na kozoongera. Ewe arabhaha na kobhoongera ubhweryakoro.
Arabhaha ubhuniibhi kwa gʉʉsi, korereke mʉtʉrɨ kʉbha bheeryakoro sikʉ zʉʉsi. Hayo neho abhaatʉ bhakukumya Mungu igʉrʉ we ebhegero bhɨnʉ tʉkʉbhahirɨra kurwa kwa niimwɨ.
Ɨrabhabhu, kʉ kʉbha emeremo ju ubhweryakoro gɨnʉ mokokora, gɨtakʉsakirya abharɨndu bha Mungu bhanʉ bhasuuhiirwɨ abheene, nawe gɨragirya abhaatʉ bhaaru bhakumyɨ Mungu.

Bharagʉnga Mungu, kʉ kʉbha emeremo janyu gereerecha imwɨ nɨ‑bhahocha bhazʉmu. Na bharamʉgʉnga kʉ kʉbha mwisiriiryɨ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu igʉrʉ wa Kiriisitʉ, na kʉ kʉbha yu ubhweryakoro bhwanyu bhwʉ ʉkʉbhasakirya ebho na abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi.
Bharabha bharabhasabhɨra kwa Mungu, bhariigomba kʉbha hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ igʉrʉ wɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi bhɨnʉ Mungu abhahɨɨrɨ imwɨ.
Akumibhwɨ Mungu kʉbhɨgʉngi bhyazɨ ɨbhɨkʉrʉ bhɨnʉ bhɨhɨtɨɨrɨɨnʼyɨ.
